notes:
Original extracted by explicit study_o = 2 and p. 888 Table 1 locator. Neutral description mentions the general proposed approach/avoidance mechanism; the printed dependent measure is preference for company names, not a direct swallowing/spitting or motivational-state measure. Replication Experiment 2 remains independently unverified: open repository connection refused; repository alternative host DNS/certificate/connection failures; DOI landing page timed out; publisher full-text link redirects to abstract; OpenAlex identifies only the same inaccessible repository as OA. No replication statistics inferred from abstract or original.
Source follow-up: Published 2016 article, accepted 2015. One bilingual excluded per experiment; Methods reports N = 203 and N = 204 but t df = 202 and 203, respectively, so no uniquely established analytic n. Replication describes original Experiment 6; supplied original study locator is 2. PDF pp. 3–4 inspected visually; printed dz and p verified.
